about: Pinned judge-finding families for the LLM-judge pack (run_llm_evals.py). Every family here was flagged by a real pack run, fixed on the DRAFT side (guardrails, prompts, templates — the judge is never tuned to pass), and is now expected NOT to recur: when the gate in judge_gate.py classifies a flagged verdict into a family listed here, the pack names it a REGRESSION in its output. A flagged verdict matching no family is a NEW FINDING and belongs in this file once understood. Signals are lowercase substrings matched against the judge's rationale; families are evaluated in file order, most specific first.

families.origin: LLM-judge pack re-run, 2026-10-10 (cases E1, M1 family): 'will proceed to underwriter review', 'is now under senior underwriter review' read as promises
families.policed_by: guardrails.no_forward_motion_in_letter (_REVIEW_COMMITMENT_PATTERNS) + drafting prompt hard line; golden cases RC1/RC2
families.title: Broker letter commits the file to a review step

families.origin: LLM-judge pack re-run, 2026-10-10: 'We will be in touch shortly' — a fair catch; a soft timeline is still a timeline
families.policed_by: guardrails.no_forward_motion_in_letter (_SOFT_TIME_PATTERNS) + drafting prompt hard line; golden case ST1
families.title: Broker letter gives a soft response timeline

families.origin: LLM-judge pack run 1, 2026-10-10 (9+ drafts flagged): 'we will move this submission forward to quote file preparation', 'proceed with quote preparation', 'standard authority' in letters
families.policed_by: guardrails.no_forward_motion_in_letter (_FORWARD_MOTION_PATTERNS, _AUTHORITY_PATTERNS) + template status language; golden cases FM1/FM2
families.title: Broker letter commits the file forward or quotes internal authority

families.origin: LLM-judge pack run 1, 2026-10-10 (case C1 family): invented revenue figures, coverage limits, and authority thresholds ($5M standard authority, $100M/$250M thresholds)
families.policed_by: drafting prompt verbatim-figure rule (facts block only) + judge receives the full verified facts the drafter saw, so legitimate figures are not misread as inventions
families.title: Drafts state figures that are not in the verified facts

families.origin: LLM-judge pack re-run, 2026-10-10 (cases E3, M1): 'source documentation not located' when it was located; an invented second discrepancy
families.policed_by: self-verification + independent reviewer read drafts against the computed facts; gap_sources wording is computed and quoted verbatim
families.title: Drafts assert specifics the facts do not support
